questions.question: The sum of the present ages of Priya and her younger brother Rohan is 44 years. Four years ago, Priya was twice as old as Rohan was at that time. What is Priya’s current age (in years)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let Priya = P, Rohan = R

P + R = 44

4 years ago ⇒ P − 4 = 2(R − 4)

⇒ P = 2R − 4

Substitute ⇒ (2R − 4) + R = 44

⇒ 3R = 48 ⇒ R = 16

⇒ P = 44 − 16 = 28

**∴ Answer = 28 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of present ages = 44

4 years ago condition

**Formula used:**

Age relation with time shift

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let Rohan’s present age = x

⇒ Priya’s present age = 44 − x

⇒ 4 years ago:

(44 − x − 4) = 2(x − 4)

⇒ 40 − x = 2x − 8

⇒ 48 = 3x ⇒ x = 16

⇒ Priya’s age = 44 − 16 = 28

**∴ The correct answer is 28 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Concept

Use present and past relations

Equation Formation

Translate statement into algebra

Time Shift

Subtract years for past ages

Key Insight

Solve simultaneous equations stepwise

questions.question: {If } (1)/(1 - tan theta) + (1)/(1 + tan theta) = 3, { and } theta { is an acute angle, find the value of } csc theta.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

1/(1 − tanθ) + 1/(1 + tanθ) = 3

⇒ ( (1 + tanθ) + (1 − tanθ) ) / (1 − tan²θ ) = 3

⇒ 2 / (1 − tan²θ) = 3

⇒ 1 − tan²θ = 2/3 ⇒ tan²θ = 1/3

⇒ tanθ = 1/√3 (acute angle)

⇒ sinθ = 1/2 ⇒ cscθ = 2

**∴ Answer = 2**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

1/(1 − tanθ) + 1/(1 + tanθ) = 3

**Formula used:**

(a/b + c/d) = (ad + bc)/bd

**Calculation:**

⇒ Combine fractions:

⇒ ( (1 + tanθ) + (1 − tanθ) ) / (1 − tan²θ ) = 3

⇒ 2 / (1 − tan²θ) = 3

⇒ 1 − tan²θ = 2/3

⇒ tan²θ = 1/3

⇒ Since θ is acute:

⇒ tanθ = 1/√3

⇒ Using standard triangle:

Opp = 1, Adj = √3 ⇒ Hyp = 2

⇒ sinθ = 1/2

⇒ cscθ = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Identity Used

1 − tan²θ = cos²θ − sin²θ relation

Triangle Method

Use right triangle for trig ratios

Acute Angle Condition

Take positive root

Key Insight

Reduce expression to single trig ratio

questions.question: A, B and C can do a work in 17 days, 51 days and 68 days, respectively. They finished together that work and gained ₹5,985 in wages. Find B's wage (in ₹).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Wages are distributed in the ratio of efficiencies when individuals work together.

Efficiency Ratio (A : B : C) = 1/17 : 1/51 : 1/68 = 12 : 4 : 3

Total ratio parts = 12 + 4 + 3 = 19 parts

B's wage = (4 ÷ 19) × 5985 = 4 × 315 = ₹1,260

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,260.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A = 17 days

Time taken by B = 51 days

Time taken by C = 68 days

Total wages earned = ₹5,985

**Concept Used:**

When persons work together from start to finish, the total wage is distributed strictly in the ratio of their individual efficiencies.

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 A
 17
 204
 12
 
 

 B
 51
 4
 
 

 C
 68
 3
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Efficiency of A, B, and C = 12 + 4 + 3 = 19 units/day

⇒ The ratio of wages of A, B, and C = 12 : 4 : 3

⇒ Total wage = 19 units = ₹5,985

⇒ Value of 1 unit = 5985 ÷ 19 = ₹315

⇒ B's share = 4 units = 4 × 315 = ₹1,260

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,260.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work and Wages

Wages are always distributed in proportion to the actual amount of work done by each individual. If persons work for the same number of days, their wages are divided directly in the ratio of their efficiencies.

Different Working Days

If individuals work for a different number of days, their share of wages will be computed in the ratio of (Efficiency × Number of working days).

Efficiency vs Days

The efficiency of a person is inversely proportional to the number of days taken to complete the work alone. Efficiency Ratio = 1/D₁ : 1/D₂ : 1/D₃.

questions.question: In an election between two candidates, 20% of the voters did not cast their votes, and all the votes cast were valid. The winner secured 70% of the votes cast and won by a margin of 23,200 votes. What was the total number of voters?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let total voters = x

Votes cast = 80% of x = 0.8x

Winner = 70%, loser = 30% ⇒ margin = 40% of votes cast

⇒ Margin = 0.4 × 0.8x = 0.32x

⇒ 0.32x = 23200 ⇒ x = 23200 ÷ 0.32 = 72500

**∴ Answer = 72,500**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

20% did not vote ⇒ 80% voted

Winner = 70%, loser = 30%

Margin = 23200

**Formula used:**

Margin = (Winner% − Loser%) × Votes cast

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let total voters = x

⇒ Votes cast = 0.8x

⇒ Margin = (70% − 30%) of 0.8x

⇒ = 40% of 0.8x = 0.4 × 0.8x = 0.32x

⇒ 0.32x = 23200

⇒ x = 23200 ÷ 0.32 = 72500

**∴ The correct answer is 72,500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Voting Concept

Use only votes cast for percentage split

Margin Formula

Margin = difference in % × total votes

Percentage Conversion

Convert % to decimal for calculation

Key Insight

Work backward from margin to total voters

questions.question: A car travels a distance of 120 km in 2 hours. What is its speed?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The core concept is to divide the total distance by the total time taken to find the uniform speed.

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Speed = 120 ÷ 2 = 60 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 60 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total distance traveled by the car = 120 km

Total time taken = 2 hours

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
 
 Distance = 120 km
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 

 
 
 Time = 2 hours
 Speed = ?

**Calculation:**

⇒ Speed = 120 km ÷ 2 hours

⇒ Speed = 60 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 60 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion

To convert speed from km/h to m/s, multiply the value by (5 ÷ 18). To convert from m/s to km/h, multiply by (18 ÷ 5).

Average Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance Covered ÷ Total Time Taken. If a vehicle covers two equal distances at speeds x and y, Average Speed = (2 × x × y) ÷ (x + y).

Relative Speed

When two bodies move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference of their individual speeds (S₁ − S₂). When moving in opposite directions, it is the sum of their speeds (S₁ + S₂).

questions.question: An article is marked 25% above its cost price. A discount is offered so that a profit of 15% is made. Find the discount percentage.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the direct relation ratio formula between MP and CP:

MP ÷ CP = (100 + Profit %) ÷ (100 − Discount %)

125 ÷ 100 = (100 + 15) ÷ (100 − D)

5 ÷ 4 = 115 ÷ (100 − D)

100 − D = (115 × 4) ÷ 5 = 92

D = 100 − 92 = 8%

**∴ The correct answer is 8%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Markup Percentage = 25%

Profit Percentage = 15%

**Formula Used:**

Discount % = (Discount ÷ MP) × 100

Discount = MP − SP

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 

 

 

 
 Markup: +25%
 Discount ?
 Profit: +15%

 
 
 CP
 100
 
 
 SP
 115

 
 MP
 125
 
 
 Discount = 125 − 115 = 10 → 8%

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the Cost Price (CP) of the article be 100 units.

⇒ The article is marked 25% above CP, so Marked Price (MP) = 100 + 25 = 125 units.

⇒ A profit of 15% is made, so Selling Price (SP) = 100 + 15 = 115 units.

⇒ Discount offered = MP − SP

⇒ Discount = 125 − 115 = 10 units.

⇒ Discount % = (Discount ÷ MP) × 100

⇒ Discount % = (10 ÷ 125) × 100

⇒ Discount % = (2 ÷ 25) × 100 = 2 × 4

⇒ Discount % = 8%

**∴ The correct answer is 8%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price & Discount

Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price (MP). The formula is: SP = MP × (100 − Discount %) ÷ 100.

Successive Discounts

If two successive discounts of a% and b% are given on an article, the equivalent discount is (a + b − ab ÷ 100)%.

Direct Relation Formula

The direct relationship between MP and CP is given by: MP ÷ CP = (100 + Profit %) ÷ (100 − Discount %).
</p

questions.question:
The height of a cylinder is 56 cm. If the circumference of its base is 176 cm, then what is the total surface area (in cm²) of this cylinder?

 {Use } pi = (22)/(7)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Circumference = 2πr = 176

⇒ r = 176 ÷ (2 × 22/7) = 28 cm

Total surface area = 2πr(h + r)

= 2 × 22/7 × 28 × (56 + 28)

= 176 × 84 = 14784

**∴ Answer = 14784 cm²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Height = 56 cm

Circumference = 176 cm

**Formula used:**

2πr = circumference

Total surface area = 2πr(h + r)

**Calculation:**

⇒ 2πr = 176

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × r = 176

⇒ r = 176 × 7 / 44 = 28 cm

⇒ TSA = 2πr(h + r)

⇒ = 2 × 22/7 × 28 × (56 + 28)

⇒ = 176 × 84 = 14784

**∴ The correct answer is 14784 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

questions.question: From an interior point of an equilateral triangle, three perpendiculars are drawn to its three sides which are of lengths 12.7 cm, 14.8 cm and 11.5 cm, respectively. Find the area of the equilateral triangle.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In an equilateral triangle, sum of perpendiculars from any interior point = altitude

Altitude = 12.7 + 14.8 + 11.5 = 39 cm

Side = (2 × altitude) / √3 = (2 × 39)/√3 = 78/√3 = 26√3

Area = (√3/4) × side²

= (√3/4) × (26√3)² = (√3/4) × 2028 = 507√3

**∴ Answer = 507√3 cm²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Perpendiculars = 12.7 cm, 14.8 cm, 11.5 cm

**Formula used:**

Altitude of equilateral triangle = sum of perpendiculars from any interior point

Area = (√3/4) × side²

**Calculation:**

⇒ Altitude = 12.7 + 14.8 + 11.5 = 39 cm

⇒ For equilateral triangle:

Altitude = (√3/2) × side

⇒ side = (2 × 39)/√3 = 26√3

⇒ Area = (√3/4) × (26√3)²

⇒ = (√3/4) × 2028

⇒ = 507√3 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 507√3 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Key Property

Sum of perpendiculars = altitude in equilateral triangle

Altitude Formula

h = (√3/2) × side

Area Formula

(√3/4) × side²

Key Insight

Convert altitude to side before area

questions.question: A taxi service charges a fixed base fare plus a variable rate per kilometre. For a 10 km trip, Raju paid ₹230 and for a 15 km trip, Meena paid ₹330. What is the base fare and the per-kilometre charge?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference method:

15 km − 10 km = 5 km ⇒ fare difference = 330 − 230 = 100

Rate per km = 100 ÷ 5 = 20

Base fare = 230 − (10 × 20) = 30

**∴ Answer = Base fare ₹30, Rate ₹20/km**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

10 km ⇒ ₹230

15 km ⇒ ₹330

**Formula used:**

Total fare = Base fare + (Rate × distance)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let base fare = B and rate per km = r

⇒ B + 10r = 230 ...(1)

⇒ B + 15r = 330 ...(2)

⇒ Subtract (1) from (2):

⇒ 5r = 100 ⇒ r = 20

⇒ Substitute in (1):

⇒ B + 200 = 230 ⇒ B = 30

**∴ The correct answer is Base fare ₹30 and rate ₹20/km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Linear Equation

Form equations using given conditions

Elimination Method

Subtract equations to find unknown

Difference Trick

Use change in distance to find rate quickly

Key Insight

Same base fare cancels while subtracting

questions.question: A, B and C can do a piece of work in 3, 10 and 15 days, respectively. How long (in days) will they take to do twice the same work, working together?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM(3, 10, 15) = 30 units.

Efficiencies of A, B and C = 10, 3 and 2 units/day respectively.

Combined efficiency = 10 + 3 + 2 = 15 units/day.

Work to be done = 2 × Total work = 2 × 30 = 60 units.

Time taken = Total work ÷ Combined efficiency = 60 ÷ 15 = 4 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A = 3 days

Time taken by B = 10 days

Time taken by C = 15 days

**Formula Used:**

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time Taken

Total time taken = Total Work ÷ Combined Efficiency

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 A
 3
 30
 10
 
 

 B
 10
 3
 
 

 C
 15
 2
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total efficiency of (A + B + C) = 10 + 3 + 2 = 15 units/day

⇒ Total work to be done = 2 × Original Total Work

⇒ Total work to be done = 2 × 30 = 60 units

⇒ Time taken by (A + B + C) together = 60 ÷ 15

⇒ Time taken = 4 days

**∴ The correct answer is 4 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes & Cisterns

Similar to Time & Work. The only difference is that an outlet pipe does negative work, so its efficiency is subtracted from the total combined efficiency.

Work & Wages

Wages are distributed in proportion to the actual work done by each person. If everyone works for the same number of days, wages are distributed exactly in the ratio of their respective efficiencies.

Alternate Day Work

If two people work on alternate days, first find the work done in a complete 2-day cycle. Multiply the cycle to reach as close to the total work as possible, then manually add the remaining work.

questions.question: In a distribution where the empirical relation holds true, if both the mode and the median are 46, find the mean.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Empirical formula: Mode = 3Median − 2Mean

Given Mode = 46, Median = 46

⇒ 46 = 3×46 − 2Mean

⇒ 46 = 138 − 2Mean

⇒ 2Mean = 92 ⇒ Mean = 46

**∴ Answer = 46**

questions.question: {Expand: } (3m - 5n)²
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Expand using the standard algebraic identity directly: (a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b².

Square of the first term: (3m)² = 9m²

Product of terms × 2: 2 × 3m × 5n = 30mn

Square of the second term: (5n)² = 25n²

Combine with negative middle term: 9m² − 30mn + 25n²

**∴ The correct answer is 9m² − 30mn + 25n².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression to expand: (3m − 5n)²

**Formula Used:**

(a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b²

**Calculations:**

⇒ Comparing the given expression with the formula, we set a = 3m and b = 5n.

⇒ Substituting the values into the formula:

⇒ (3m − 5n)² = (3m)² − 2 × (3m) × (5n) + (5n)²

⇒ Simplifying each term separately:

⇒ (3m)² = 9m²

⇒ 2 × 3m × 5n = 30mn

⇒ (5n)² = 25n²

⇒ Putting it all together:

⇒ 9m² − 30mn + 25n²

**∴ The correct answer is 9m² − 30mn + 25n².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Standard Algebraic Identities

(a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²

(a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b²

Difference of Squares

a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b)

Perfect Cubes

(a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b)

(a − b)³ = a³ − b³ − 3ab(a − b)

questions.question: In quadrilateral PQRS, the bisectors of angle R and angle S meet at the point T (inside the quadrilateral) and angle STR = 17^circ . If the ratio of angle P to angle Q is 8 : 9, then what is the difference between the measures of angle Q and angle P ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

By the quadrilateral angle bisector property: ∠P + ∠Q = 2 × ∠STR = 2 × 17° = 34°

Given the ratio of ∠P : ∠Q = 8 : 9 ⇒ Total = 8 + 9 = 17 parts

17 parts = 34° ⇒ 1 part = 2°

Difference between ∠Q and ∠P = 9 parts − 8 parts = 1 part = 2°

**∴ The correct answer is 2°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
• 
• P Q R S T 17° 

**Given:**

In quadrilateral PQRS, ST and RT are bisectors of ∠S and ∠R.

∠STR = 17°

Ratio of ∠P : ∠Q = 8 : 9

**Formula Used:**

The angle formed by the bisectors of two adjacent angles of a quadrilateral is equal to half the sum of the remaining two angles.

∠STR = (∠P + ∠Q) ÷ 2

**Calculations:**

⇒ 17° = (∠P + ∠Q) ÷ 2

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q = 17° × 2 = 34°

Let ∠P = 8x and ∠Q = 9x.

⇒ 8x + 9x = 34°

⇒ 17x = 34°

⇒ x = 2°

Now, we calculate the difference between the measures of ∠Q and ∠P:

⇒ Difference = ∠Q − ∠P

⇒ Difference = 9x − 8x

⇒ Difference = x

⇒ Difference = 2°

**∴ The correct answer is 2°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Angles of a Quadrilateral

The sum of all four interior angles of any general quadrilateral is always 360°. The generalized polygon sum formula is (n − 2) × 180°, where n is the number of sides.

Angle Between Adjacent Bisectors

The angle formed by the intersection of the interior bisectors of any two adjacent angles of a quadrilateral is exactly equal to half the combined sum of the remaining two interior angles.

Angle Bisectors in Parallelograms

In any parallelogram, the interior angle bisectors of two consecutive angles will always intersect exactly at 90° because consecutive angles are supplementary (add up to 180°).

questions.question: Walking at (4)/(7) of his normal speed from his home, Shahid is 12 minutes late in reaching his office. The usual time taken by him to cover the distance between his home and his office is:

Speed = 4/7 ⇒ time becomes 7/4

Extra time = (7/4 − 1) = 3/4 of usual time

3/4 of usual time = 12

Usual time = 12 × 4/3 = 16

**∴ Answer = 16 minutes**

Time ∝ 1 / Speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let normal time = T

⇒ New speed = (4/7) of normal ⇒ new time = (7/4)T

⇒ Increase in time = (7/4)T − T

⇒ = (3/4)T

⇒ Given increase = 12

⇒ (3/4)T = 12

⇒ T = 12 × 4/3

⇒ T = 16 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 16 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

questions.question: The average age of 43 students of a class is 25 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 26 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:

Age of new member = Old average + (Total members × Increase in average)

⇒ Age of teacher = 25 + 44 × (26 − 25)

⇒ Age of teacher = 25 + 44 × 1

⇒ Age of teacher = 25 + 44 = 69

**∴ The correct answer is 69 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of students = 43

Average age of 43 students = 25 years

Average age of 44 people (43 students + 1 teacher) = 26 years

**Formula Used:**

Total Value = Average × Number of Items

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total age of 43 students = 43 × 25

⇒ Total age of 43 students = 1075 years

⇒ Total age of whole group (44 people) = 44 × 26

⇒ Total age of whole group = 1144 years

Net Deviation Method for Averages

When a new person joins a group, their value = Old Average + (Total members after joining) × (Change in Average).

Leaving Group Deviation

When a person leaves a group, their value = Old Average − (Remaining members) × (Change in Average).

Combined Average

Combined Average of two groups = (N₁A₁ + N₂A₂) ÷ (N₁ + N₂), where N is the number of items and A is the respective average.

questions.question: A garrison of 1209 men has provisions for 20 days. How long (in days) will the provisions last if the garrison is increased by 403 men?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since the total provisions are constant, the number of men is inversely proportional to the number of days.

Ratio of Men = 1209 : (1209 + 403) = 1209 : 1612 = 3 : 4

Ratio of Days (inverse) = 4 : 3

Here, 4 parts → 20 days (given)

Therefore, 3 parts → (20 ÷ 4) × 3 = 15 days

**∴ The correct answer is 15 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial number of men (M₁) = 1209

Initial number of days (D₁) = 20

New number of men (M₂) = 1209 + 403 = 1612

 
 
 Provisions
 M1 × D1
 M1 = 1209
 D1 = 20
 
 
 =

 
 
 Provisions
 M2 × D2
 M2 = 1612
 D2 = ?
 
 Area represents constant provisions (Inverse Proportion)

**Formula Used:**

For constant provisions, M₁ × D₁ = M₂ × D₂

**Calculations:**

⇒ 1209 × 20 = 1612 × D₂

⇒ D₂ = (1209 × 20) ÷ 1612

⇒ D₂ = (3 × 20) ÷ 4

⇒ D₂ = 15

**∴ The correct answer is 15 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Chain Rule (MDH Concept)

If M₁ persons can do W₁ work in D₁ days working H₁ hours a day, and M₂ persons can do W₂ work in D₂ days working H₂ hours a day, then (M₁ × D₁ × H₁) ÷ W₁ = (M₂ × D₂ × H₂) ÷ W₂.

Direct Proportion

Two quantities are in direct proportion if they increase or decrease together, keeping their ratio constant. (x ∝ y ⇒ x = ky)

Inverse Proportion

Two quantities are in inverse proportion if an increase in one causes a proportional decrease in the other. (x ∝ 1/y ⇒ xy = k)
